mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate at or below 0.25% compresses equity discount rates, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days. This signal is continuously active when the rate condition holds.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS <= 0.25, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: CPIAUCSL exceeding 215.0 signals inflationary pressure requiring Fed tightening, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL > 215.0, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent low federal funds rate (<= 0.25%) and CPIAUCSL below 215.0 indicate stable monetary conditions, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days through interaction of two monetary indicators.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS <= 0.25 AND CPIAUCSL < 215.0, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: High unemployment (UNRATE > 7.5%) triggers Fed policy accommodation, supporting equity valuations and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of instances where UNRATE > 7.5, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts below 450 indicate weak residential demand, signaling economic slowdown and generating negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 60% of instances where HOUST < 450, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Residential fixed investment above 350000 indicates strong housing sector growth, supporting economic expansion and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 60% of instances where RSAFS > 350000, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production below 100 indicates manufacturing contraction, signaling economic weakness and generating negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 60% of instances where INDPRO < 100, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent housing starts below 450 and industrial production below 100 indicate dual-sector weakness, generating negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days through interaction of demand and supply indicators.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of instances where HOUST < 450 AND INDPRO < 100, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.
